name: Canh chua ca khoai
summary: Canh chua cá khoai is a sour soup of a long, round fish with pineapple, tamarind, tomato, bean sprouts, ngổ, and spring onion. The flesh is soft and translucent, and the bowl smells of pineapple and tomato, sweet, then cleanly sour.
origin: Can Gio. The fish is described as mainly central, and the soup as a local plate.
howToEat: Eat it as a soup. The story says the fish was not popular in Cần Giờ until this sour soup.
seoTitle: Canh chua ca khoai — sour fish soup in Can Gio
seoDescription: Canh chua cá khoai is a sour soup of soft translucent fish, pineapple, and tamarind.
texture: Soft translucent flesh and very fine bones.
taste: Pineapple and tomato fragrance, natural sweetness, and a clean sour from tamarind.
